lines.t: We'll be right back.
Jordan is fallen yet the waters flee
For the ark has entered the stream
The captain's cry steals the harps of the men
For the Holy One goes before them
Cain's proud towers glimmer with fear
Their courage fails behind their walls
Israel marches in discipline
Silenced trumpets ready to shatter the gates
Seven days they circle the stronghold
Seven times they tread the dust
Not by steel nor strength of arm
But by the word that cannot fail
South, you armies of the living God
Let the walls fall into the dust
He who rides upon the stone goes before
The man of war leads the charge
Steel in hand, fire in bone
They cross the river never turning back
Every step is conquest
Every breath is war
Yet that day was only a shadow
Stones fell but hearts remained like flint
Now the earth is filled with violence
Abominations rise in every land
Fire awaits the towers of the proud
The kingdom stands on chargements flame
The day draws near like a gathering storm
The mighty one stands at the threshold
An unseen army has been numbered
Repentant hidden places of the heart
Left to stand amid the ruin
Raised to lead the lost to shelter
They wear the seal no man can break
They bear a name the world can erase
They shout salvation into the wind
They do not bow, they do not break
Curl up your loins, you chosen men
Sons of Zion, take your race
The Lord of hosts and gods before you
The Holy One is your shield
You are the trumpets of his breath
You are the flame from his mouth
You march through burning cities
You never break, you never turn
Cities fall and darkness spreads
Yet these do not fail
Multitudes fall on every side
Yet they stand unshaken
Hands upheld by an unseen arm
They walk the eye of the storm
They rise on wings like an eagle host
They hide a nameless remnant in the waste
They level the hills and tear down the high place
Preparing a highway for the king
Their number is 144 times 1,000
Not one is lost, not one afraid
They are towers ringed with iron
Walls no hammer can break
Their shout is like trumpets around a doomed city
Their word is like steel that cuts the night
They bear the spear that pierces pride
They bear the basin that washes the broken
They cleanse the feet of the repentant
Until the king himself appears
Prepare the path in this desert of bones
Straighten the way in this scorched land
Raise up the low and bring down the high
Cut a string, roll through the waste
The glory of the Lord is growing near
Every eye will see his light
One host cries out with a single voice
Make straight the highway of our God
They trample serpents and topple towers
They strike the idols from their throne
Yet in their hands is mercy's water
At their side the towel of a servant
They carry sword in cleansing
Judgment and kindness in one day
As the tribes once crossed the river on
Saw these cross nations bearing the seal
As the first fortress fell at a trumpet blast
So the last empire burns at the shout of the king
The rider comes with garments stained
His title blazing upon his thigh
He sends them forth as a vanguard
God's flame, to clear the field for his glory
Jamin's proud strong from a defiled earth
Following the lamb wherever he goes
No deceit is found upon their lips
No fear is found within their hearts
They raise the final war cry of Zion
They sound the last warning to a dying world
When their testimony is complete
The heavens split and the king descends
The captain once seen by the river returns
Now crowned, robed in burning blood
He stands at the ancient gate of the city
And all creation falls before him
